_about: Copies of the pages and documents read 4 October 2026 for the war memorial sourcing pass (inventory/review/war-memorial-sourcing-2026-10-04.md). Wayback captures were fetched with the id_ flag (the original page without the archive's banner). ABMC and DANFS pages are JavaScript applications or refused a scripted download, so they are saved as transcriptions (.txt) of what the browser showed. The VA Gravesite Locator pages are the HTML result pages of POST searches; the query is in the url field.
